mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.0% consistently compresses equity discount rates and elevates risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days across all macro regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it triggers a restrictive monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates and reduces forward returns, producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 3.8% and 3-month employment growth exceeding 0.5% indicates labor market tightening that accelerates consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.8% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.8% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes with CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2.5%, monetary policy tightening expectations suppress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production index above 105 (2017=100) signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO remains above 105.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts above 1500 thousand units and retail sales growth exceeding 0.3% in 3 months indicate strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS growth > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS growth > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 3.0%, it signals a labor market shortage that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles with sustained 3-month FEDFUNDS increases exceeding 0.5% per month, higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5% per month for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% per month for 3 months.
